answer: The vault counter is kept in cedar and summit publishes each reset. Anyone therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 35 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 35 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 2464 identities would post 4520 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
